US1.description: All 14 valid reference cases pass with exact line values and totals
All money values are integers in cents (no floats or decimals)

US2.description: All 10 invalid cases raise `QuoteError` with non-empty understandable messages
No quotation is produced for invalid inputs

US3.description: CLI command `python -m quotation.pricing` parses JSON input and returns 0 on success
CLI prints `Fehler: <message>` to stderr on error with exit code 2

US4.description: Discounts applied per line based on tier boundaries (49/50, 99/100) with ROUND_HALF_UP
Shipping calculated as 1200 cents if goods net < 50000 cents, otherwise 0
